events.body:
## Bug

`website/views/social.py` imports only `Paginator` from `django.core.paginator` (line 1), but `queue_social_view` catches `except (PageNotAnInteger, EmptyPage):` at line 16. Neither name is imported, so when `paginator.page(page_number)` raises one of them, evaluating the except tuple itself raises `NameError: name 'PageNotAnInteger' is not defined`. The fallback that is supposed to recover from a bad page number crashes the view (500) instead.

## Repro

Request the social queue view with `?page=abc` (non-integer → PageNotAnInteger) or `?page=99999` (out of range → EmptyPage). Instead of falling back to page 1, the request 500s.

## Suggested fix

    from django.core.paginator import EmptyPage, PageNotAnInteger, Paginator

Found by static analysis (ruff F821); no star-import masks the names. AI model used in analysis: Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code).
